programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: In the Mat-su, Halloween brings mayhem as Troopers respond to a roadside meltdown and recover a trove of credit cards in different names; the season's first snowfall causes chaos in Fairbanks and in Nome, Troopers bring in a wanted man as a typhoon moves in.

programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: It's a wild Alaska summer day as troopers locate a naked wolf hunter, track a suspected felon through the woods and respond to an animal hoarder in a remote village just north of the Arctic Circle.

programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: Alaska State Troopers pursue gas thieves, use pepper balls to arrest a barricaded suspect and respond to shots fired in a remote village, showing the risks of policing Alaska's wild terrain.

programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: Troopers respond to one call after another, from an apparently aggressive rabbit to a family member involved in a car crash.

programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: Troopers go undercover to bring down a wanted fugitive, arrest a driver who throws drugs out the window during a traffic stop and engage in a high-speed pursuit on city streets.

programs.title: Alaska State Troopers
programs.desc: In the Mat-Su, Troopers catch a runner connected to an alleged Facebook scam and arrest a suspect wanted on murder charges; in Fairbanks, two hunters are caught butchering a moose in a bank drive-thru.
